supply.title: EIA Weekly Inventories
supply.note: Context only — not in the composite. Weekly EIA prints vs consensus (1σ: crude 4.0M, gasoline 1.5M, distillate 2.0M bbl; inside ±0.4σ = noise). Colour shows the direction the print implies for the commodity (build bigger than forecast = bearish). Expectancy audit (170 weekly prints, 2023–26): the surprise is priced on release day and carries no 1–4 week edge (hit 48–54%), so it is displayed for situational awareness rather than scored.
